C-QA-ARCHIVE-LIFECYCLE.Summary: Track and safely remove exact-QA app archives and optional sidecars, and isolate future packaged cache restoration from legacy untracked archives.
C-QA-ARCHIVE-LIFECYCLE.Problem: The pinned Tauri action creates a macOS .app.tar.gz even without release uploads. Current QA discovery does not record this completed binary copy. The actual packaged job saved its ordinary cache after cleanup; direct remote archive membership was not measured. New-identity-only cleanup cannot safely adopt an old archive restored from that namespace.

Goals.Goal: Own and remove only newly created exact-current-identity .app.tar.gz and optional .sig using existing protected digest-based cleanup.
Avoid legacy packaged cache entries without deleting remote/dependency caches or changing other jobs.
Retain truthful archive metadata/absence evidence and preserve every native smoke, handoff, warning and release boundary.

Private source-baseline binds actual current preimages; root freshly revalidates actual all-source/archive/current-owner baseline and resulting HEAD/tree after carrier final/archive/current, before any spec/plan approval or observed edit.

For macos-arm64 only, discover exact target/<identity.target>/release/bundle/macos/<identity.productName>.app.tar.gz and the exact adjacent .app.tar.gz.sig when present. No broad glob or arbitrary product-name parsing. Any preexisting same-identity archive/sidecar, including file/directory/link, causes prepareQa refusal without adopting or changing it. Other-run identities are untouched.

New archives/sidecars must pass existing safeParents/measuredFile checks: contained regular nonlinked nonempty file, descriptor inode/device stability, exact bytes/size/SHA. NonGoals.NonGoal: No deletion or inspection of remote cache payloads, unknown historical outputs, shared cache files, owner profiles or keys; no broad archive sanitizer.
No tauri-action inputs/pins, updater/signing policy, cache path/performance redesign, production release jobs or native protocol change.

Existing cache contracts reject intended new QA keys before their narrowly scoped update. All fixtures stop/clean in outer finally; no native/real archive execution.

Positive actual filesystem controls own nonempty archive with or without signature and signature alone after partial output; persistent state records exact path/kind/size/digest, repeated recording is idempotent and protected cleanup removes them with verified absence. Preexisting same-identity output is refused unchanged.

Exact unrelated old identity/prefix-near-miss and dependency cache files remain byte-identical. File/parent links, nonregular/empty archive and permission/I/O errors fail truthfully; changed measured archive stays retained, and independent already-owned safe outputs still receive cleanup attempts. Existing unresolved process/mount/gate tests remain intact.

Packaged QA cache key/restore only use qa-v2 and same platform/toolchain/lock identity. Mutations restoring old v1, a generic/cross-platform prefix, missing hash/dimension or changing cache paths fail. Complete workflow AST inverse retains the old historical digest and rejects unrelated controls.

Five scoped paths and approved docs are hash-bound; all outside source/archive/current nodes and native runtime branches are preserved.
